**The Render view's camera answers the left drag, and Space flies up**

In the Render Viewport, a left drag always turns the view about the point under the pointer, whatever else is going on: while walking with W A S D, with the camera unlocked from the view, after a double-click or after looking around with the right button; Shift with it slides and the wheel comes toward the pointer, even while a walk key is held (the wheel sets the walking speed only with the right button held). Moving the camera by hand stops a camera path playing, which used to take it straight back. Space goes up and C down, as flying in the game, beside E and Q; while a Timeline is shown, Space keeps playing and pausing. A key pressed with ⌘ (a shortcut such as ⌘S) no longer keeps the camera walking after it is let go.
